identity:
Use the Warp Obelisk to reach the surface and begin an expedition to a random place on the surface.  Find the exit marked on your map and get there in time with all the loot you can carry and to bring it back to the island!
Dying on expedition will return you home safely, but you will lose EVERYTHING you had with you.  Keep spare gear at home so you can quickly resupply!

The time limit is enforced by warp pulses, which hit you at regular intervals.  After 8 pulses, you suffer warpsickness, which rapidly reduces your stats with each pulse.  After 12 pulses, your body begins to disintegrate, taking damage until you die.  Get home safely to reset the pulses!

Certain upgrades can unlock new varieties of expeditions, or improve your survivability.

identity: Hope is dead, it rode alone up to the gates of Hell.  It was crushed in a mass of people.  You were pushed away to the edges of the crowd.  The last you saw was hope pulled down screaming.  Nothing will ever have meaning again.
